'''Chibias''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] near [[Sibisime]].

==History==
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Chibias was governed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Egron]].

Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Egron tried to enrich by selling the control codes of a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] to [[Markko]], the leader of the local [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cell. Their plan failed because they didn't manage to decrypt the codes. They tried to force the young [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[Zakarisz Ghent|Ghent]] to help them but he was rescued by [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. Ironically, she was just come to Chibias to attend a symphonic concert. Governor Egron was killed by Mara Jade for his [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Empire.<ref name="Handoff">{{GamerCite|10|Handoff|reprint=1}}</ref>
